code_note: source_sha names the commit whose tracked code under crates/ is byte-identical to the measured release build (no code changes between measurement and commit; docs/examples/benchmarks only).

method.server_command: eggserve --directory <tmp root with f1k.bin (1024 B) + f1m.bin (1048576 B)> --port <ephemeral> --log-format none
method.client: CPython http.client, keep-alive, 16 worker threads, 2000 requests per trial, 3 trials per size
method.note: Loopback suitability smoke only. Absolute numbers are machine-specific and are not release gates; see benchmarks/README.md regression policy.

variance_note: Within a run, trial-to-trial spread is under 5%. Between runs on the same machine the absolute level moved ~1.7x (power/frequency state, background load), which is why absolute RPS must never gate CI and release comparisons must be same-machine, same-session, baseline-relative. Zero errors, timeouts, or rejections in all 12,000 requests per run; server peak RSS stayed under 7 MB, confirming bounded steady-state memory for static serving.
